better_model_summary: Under 1-step rolling evaluation, Naive (Lag-1) achieved lower MAE (63.75 vs 65.63) and lower RMSE (84.39 vs 84.66) because it adapts immediately to the growing 2017 volume level. Seasonal Naive achieved lower MAPE (28.03% vs 30.93%) by matching the annual seasonal curve, but underpredicts overall due to the unmodeled +25.9% year-over-year upward trend.
